CONFIDENTIAL
Telephone No.
RUSHOLME 3381.

BOX No. 500,
MANCHESTER.

2nd August 1944.

Ref: 6517.
Your Ref: PF.60074.

Mr. R.G. Micklethwaite,
F.3.m., Oxford.

Please refer to my letter of the 22nd July about Arthur William OLDAG @ John OLDAY.

I now enclose a copy of a report which I have received from the Chief Constable of Birkenhead from which you will see that OLDAG is not known by the Chinese residents in Birkenhead.

[handwritten signature]
Major F.W. Towns.

ENCL Report
- 4 AUG 1944
TO F3M
REF
